overview.description: The F/M 10-Year Investment Grade Corporate Bond ETF (ZTEN) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund tracks an index of equally weighted US investment grade corporate bonds with remaining term maturities of approximately ten years. ZTEN was launched on Jan 10, 2024 and is issued by F/m Investments.
